description: Makes a new great.dj playlist and returns its link, its tracks with their YouTube video ids (reuse those ids in later calls), and any songs that weren't found. Each song is a {"id": "<YouTube video id>"} object (preferred: free and exact) or an "Artist - Title" string, looked up on YouTube (slow, and limited per hour). Reuse the video ids returned by search_songs and earlier calls instead of looking songs up again. With an API key it belongs to the key's account. Without one it's an anonymous public playlist and the result has an edit_token: keep it for the rest of the conversation, it's the only way to change the playlist later and can't be recovered.

private.description: true (default with an API key): only the owner can edit it; false: anyone can. Anyone with the link can listen either way. true needs an API key.

songs.description: Each song is a {"id": "<YouTube video id>"} object (preferred: free and exact) or an "Artist - Title" string, looked up on YouTube (slow, and limited per hour). Reuse the video ids returned by search_songs and earlier calls instead of looking songs up again. At most 100 per call.

name: create_playlist

edit_token.description: Anonymous playlists only: needed to edit it later. Can't be recovered.

owner.description: Username, or null for anonymous playlists

private.description: Only its owner can edit it (anyone with the link can listen)

id.description: YouTube video id: reuse it instead of the title

unmatched.description: Songs that weren't found on YouTube (not added)

title: Create a playlist
